title: 找到所有好字符串
summary: 统计长度 n、字典序位于 s1 与 s2 之间且不含 evil 子串的字符串数量。
insight: 用 KMP 状态表示当前后缀与 evil 前缀匹配长度，再做带上下界约束的逐字符 DP；一旦匹配完整 evil 就舍弃。
pitfalls: KMP 失配需要沿前缀函数回退
状态同时包含位置、匹配长度和两个紧约束标记

solutions.title: 上下界 KMP 数位动态规划
solutions.idea: 在字典序上下界内枚举字符并携带禁串自动机状态。
steps: 构造 evil 的 prefix 与 matched×26 转移表
matched==evil.length 返回零，position==n 返回一；记忆化非终止状态

code.java: class Solution { private static final int MOD=1_000_000_007;private String low,high,evil;private int n,m;private int[][] transition;private int[][][][] memo;private int dfs(int position,int matched,int tightLow,int tightHigh){if(matched==m)return 0;if(position==n)return 1;if(memo[position][matched][tightLow][tightHigh]!=-1)return memo[position][matched][tightLow][tightHigh];char from=tightLow==1?low.charAt(position):'a',to=tightHigh==1?high.charAt(position):'z';long answer=0;for(char value=from;value<=to;value++)answer=(answer+dfs(position+1,transition[matched][value-'a'],tightLow==1&&value==from?1:0,tightHigh==1&&value==to?1:0))%MOD;return memo[position][matched][tightLow][tightHigh]=(int)answer;}public int findGoodStrings(int n,String s1,String s2,String evil){this.n=n;this.low=s1;this.high=s2;this.evil=evil;this.m=evil.length();int[] prefix=new int[m];for(int i=1;i<m;i++){int length=prefix[i-1];while(length>0&&evil.charAt(i)!=evil.charAt(length))length=prefix[length-1];if(evil.charAt(i)==evil.charAt(length))length++;prefix[i]=length;}transition=new int[m][26];for(int state=0;state<m;state++)for(int letter=0;letter<26;letter++){int length=state;char value=(char)('a'+letter);while(length>0&&evil.charAt(length)!=value)length=prefix[length-1];if(evil.charAt(length)==value)length++;transition[state][letter]=length;}memo=new int[n][m][2][2];for(int[][][] a:memo)for(int[][] b:a)for(int[] c:b)Arrays.fill(c,-1);return dfs(0,0,1,1);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private val mod=1_000_000_007;private lateinit var low:String;private lateinit var high:String;private lateinit var evil:String;private lateinit var transition:Array<IntArray>;private lateinit var memo:Array<Array<Array<IntArray>>>;private var n=0;private var m=0;private fun dfs(position:Int,matched:Int,tightLow:Int,tightHigh:Int):Int{if(matched==m)return 0;if(position==n)return 1;if(memo[position][matched][tightLow][tightHigh]!=-1)return memo[position][matched][tightLow][tightHigh];val from=if(tightLow==1)low[position] else 'a';val to=if(tightHigh==1)high[position] else 'z';var answer=0L;for(value in from..to)answer=(answer+dfs(position+1,transition[matched][value-'a'],if(tightLow==1&&value==from)1 else 0,if(tightHigh==1&&value==to)1 else 0))%mod;memo[position][matched][tightLow][tightHigh]=answer.toInt();return answer.toInt()};fun findGoodStrings(n:Int,s1:String,s2:String,evil:String):Int{this.n=n;this.low=s1;this.high=s2;this.evil=evil;this.m=evil.length;val prefix=IntArray(m);for(i in 1 until m){var length=prefix[i-1];while(length>0&&evil[i]!=evil[length])length=prefix[length-1];if(evil[i]==evil[length])length++;prefix[i]=length};transition=Array(m){IntArray(26)};for(state in 0 until m)for(letter in 0..25){var length=state;val value=('a'.code+letter).toChar();while(length>0&&evil[length]!=value)length=prefix[length-1];if(evil[length]==value)length++;transition[state][letter]=length};memo=Array(n){Array(m){Array(2){IntArray(2){-1}}}};return dfs(0,0,1,1)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { static const int MOD=1000000007;string low,high,evil;int n,m;vector<vector<int>> transition;vector<vector<array<array<int,2>,2>>> memo;int dfs(int position,int matched,int tightLow,int tightHigh){if(matched==m)return 0;if(position==n)return 1;int& cached=memo[position][matched][tightLow][tightHigh];if(cached!=-1)return cached;char from=tightLow?low[position]:'a',to=tightHigh?high[position]:'z';long long answer=0;for(char value=from;value<=to;++value)answer=(answer+dfs(position+1,transition[matched][value-'a'],tightLow&&value==from,tightHigh&&value==to))%MOD;return cached=answer;}public:int findGoodStrings(int n,string s1,string s2,string evil){this->n=n;low=s1;high=s2;this->evil=evil;m=evil.size();vector<int> prefix(m);for(int i=1;i<m;++i){int length=prefix[i-1];while(length&&evil[i]!=evil[length])length=prefix[length-1];if(evil[i]==evil[length])++length;prefix[i]=length;}transition.assign(m,vector<int>(26));for(int state=0;state<m;++state)for(int letter=0;letter<26;++letter){int length=state;char value='a'+letter;while(length&&evil[length]!=value)length=prefix[length-1];if(evil[length]==value)++length;transition[state][letter]=length;}memo.assign(n,vector<array<array<int,2>,2>>(m));for(auto& a:memo)for(auto& b:a)for(auto& c:b)c.fill(-1);return dfs(0,0,1,1);} };
